method: DGX Spark, 640x384, 97 frames at 24 fps, through the app. video_camera_move: median LTX execution of the first ten completed runs, excluding queue wait, and the largest sampled GPU process footprint (40.76 GB, rounded up). camera_layout: median of the whole layout stage (MoGe depth, its download, local CPU projection, layout encoding and upload preparation), and the largest sampled depth-step footprint (2.42 GB, rounded up). Warm shared-process measurements, not a cold-start guarantee.
